restoration.note: restore each source clip; output <uuid>_restored.wav; the released manifest scores restored audio only
restoration.loader: mono 16 kHz, fixed 10 s (160k samples): longer clips truncated, shorter ones zero-padded, so every clip is handed to a system at the same length

span_rule: trim the restored wav to [from_s, to_s] before embedding; absent = whole clip
